promptTemplate: Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 x 1536. Background: fill the entire square with solid {background}. Keep it visible in every open area and corners not occupied by the character; the assigned emergence corner must be occupied by the character. Subject: one extremely simplified, cute, endearing {subject}, reduced to one soft rounded continuous silhouette and one defining feature: {feature}. Complexity: use only 4–7 large basic shapes and at most two broad internal color regions. Use two simple eyes and one tiny mouth only if useful. Remove every nonessential line, outline, anatomical detail, texture, and decoration. Readable at 32 x 32. Color behavior: exactly three semantic colors, the named background plus exactly two character colors: {colors}. Organize these two colors into broad purposeful masses, reusing the darker color for facial marks. Composition: upright and emerging from the {corner}, filling about 85–95% of the square. Cropping at the bottom or assigned side is welcome. Preserve both paired identifying features. Never center or bottom-center. Style: simplification, cuteness, lovable baby-like appeal, large soft forms, compact proportions, thick rounded contours, ultra-clean graphic treatment. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment. Finish: only the character on the full-canvas background, normal square outer corners. Constraints: Use no text or watermark. Add no borders, frames, cards, or presentation masks. Include one character only, with no extra subjects or scenery. Use no fragile lines, sharp tips, unnecessary outlines, tiny details, or decorative marks. Add no photorealistic material, dramatic bevel, glossy hotspot, deep occlusion, extrusion, strong three-dimensional rendering, or external cast shadow. Keep the background solid and uniform, with no texture, vignette, or lighting variation.
